Report mandates (9 report mandates)

Statutory duties that require this agency to publish or file a report, with a City Record filing receipt when that report appears.

  • ◆Mandate · Submit semiannual reports of citywide catch basin inspection, cleanup, maintenance and repair, disaggregated by community board, to the mayor and the council, including specified inspection, clogging, repair, complaint-response, and resolution-time information.
    report · annual · §2, subdivision f · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit the study findings to the mayor and the council.
    report · deadline: no later than one year after the effective date of the local law that added this chapter · one-time · Administrative Code § 24-1102(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a report on progress in implementing the required plan during the prior fiscal year.
    report · deadline: By no later than six months after the end of each fiscal year, beginning with the first fiscal year that commences more than one year after the effective date of the local law that added this section. · annual · § 24-530(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Provide the Council and the Mayor an annual report containing information on lead water supply mains and service lines, replacement efforts, notification efforts, and public outreach and education efforts.
    report · deadline: No later than December 1, 2018 · annual · Administrative Code § 24-309.1(f) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report to the mayor and speaker of the council covering the specified sampling results, costs, effectiveness, recommendations, extension options, weekly-testing plan, and permanency recommendations.
    report · one-time · § 24-531(d) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Update the plan and report to the mayor and the council on pumpout facilities installed and planned, installation priorities, and progress toward establishing all of the city’s coastal waters as no-discharge zones.
    report · deadline: By March 1 of every year until all of the city’s coastal waters are designated as no-discharge zones · annual · § 22-112(f)(4) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit quarterly reports to the mayor, the speaker of the council and the public advocate regarding the inspection, cleanup, maintenance and repair of catch basins, disaggregated by community district.
    report · quarterly · Administrative Code § 24-503(f) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Identify catch basins not unclogged or repaired within five days in the quarterly report.
    report · quarterly · Administrative Code § 24-503(e) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report on progress in implementing the plan required by subdivision a during the prior fiscal year, including specified plan, funding, expenditure, and groundwater-study updates.
    report · deadline: By no later than 6 months after the end of each fiscal year, beginning with the first fiscal year that commences more than 1 year after the effective date · annual · Administrative Code § 24-530(b), as amended by § 1 · Source law↗
